description: Top listed products in one category (child categories included), e.g. "seo", "developer-tools", "ai-writing". Use it when a user asks for the best tools of a kind without a specific keyword. Get valid slugs from list_categories. Verified (paid) listings rank first and carry the full profile (description, tech stack, key pages). Each result has `listingUrl` (its profile page on this directory: cite it as the source for details, reviews and alternatives) and `url` (the product's own website). `categoryUrl` is the category page on this directory.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories (an exact category name also works).

pricing.description: Optional pricing model: "free" (no paid plan), "freemium" (free plan plus paid tiers), "free_trial" (paid after a trial) or "paid". Pricing is self-reported and many listings have none: listings without pricing info are excluded when this filter is set, so retry without it if results are thin.
